nativeCreationBeforeEdit.evidence: browser_multiview.rs currently calls .focused(!pane.id.starts_with("chzzk-auto-")) for newly created panes, then creates them at 1x1 and immediately hides them. Locally installed Wry 0.55.1 webview2/mod.rs lines 539-548 independently confirms attributes.focused=true directly calls ICoreWebView2Controller.MoveFocus(PROGRAMMATIC), including child WebViews. The existing automatic video path already opts out, but ordinary chat/video creation does not. Thus a delayed pane creation can programmatically take keyboard focus before it is visible. nativeRoutingInvestigation.symptomQualification: The user's follow-up at 100% excludes the independently reproduced 50%/native-max mutation loop as the direct cause. A blinking DOM caret plus working mouse-based emoticons does not establish that keyboard focus is owned by the chat WebView. Root's read-only accessibility snapshot reported the video player as focused; that is corroborating evidence, not a full native message trace.
nativeRoutingInvestigation.localSourceEvidence: Installed tauri-runtime-wry 2.11.4 lib.rs creates WindowChild through build_as_child (line 5245). Installed Wry 0.55.1 skips its top-level focus-restoring parent subclass for child WebViews; its WRY_WEBVIEW container only forwards WM_SETFOCUS to its first child HWND. Tauri's GotFocus/LostFocus handlers update bookkeeping and synthesized window focus events but do not route a mouse click to another controller. The app currently has no per-pane user-pointer focus repair. The accepted native_focus.rs activation repair deliberately does not override an already-focused child and is not changed by this batch.
nativeRoutingInvestigation.excludedWithoutEvidence: No evidence that browser_player_ui.js handles keys from the separate chat document, that chat composition content is rewritten, or that a keyboard accelerator handler suppresses chat characters. nativeRoutingInvestigation.candidateForRootReview: A narrowly scoped per-pane native pointer-down repair can call MoveFocus(PROGRAMMATIC) only for the user's actual click in a visible enabled foreground pane whose native focus is elsewhere. Do not call from timers, DOM focus observers, GotFocus, generic activation, or keyboard handlers. Preserve composition and original DOM input. WM_PARENTNOTIFY is a documented descendant-pointer path, but real WebView2 forwarding must be validated because WS_EX_NOPARENTNOTIFY can suppress it. browser_host/auto_watch native implementation is root-owned and remains untouched by this agent.

nativePointerBeforeEdit.authority: Root authorized this agent to implement a narrow native focus helper after reviewing the latest user clarification and existing code. No running-app interaction or restart is authorized by this implementation step.
nativePointerBeforeEdit.decision: Install a scoped subclass on each owned official pane container. React only to a native left-button press in that container or its descendants, not hover, focus, activation, timers, keys or window creation. Require the pane's trusted root to be foreground, both windows enabled, pane/controller visible, actual hit-test HWND in that pane, focus outside that pane, and no reentrancy. MoveFocus(PROGRAMMATIC) then resumes normal pointer dispatch. Preserve official DOM/caret/value and main-window Alt-Tab implementation. Remove subclass ownership on WM_NCDESTROY. Because Chromium can suppress WM_PARENTNOTIFY, add a separate exact-URL, per-pane nonce pointer-only message fallback: injected top-frame code reports trusted primary pointerdown, and native additionally requires the physical left button still down. Do not extend the capture/Tauri command bridge. Its callback holds Weak<State>, never a controller reference cycle. Record repair success only when native focus readback is in the intended pane; log no input contents.
